annotations.title: Create a shared expense group link

description: Use when the user wants a shared place for a group (trip, flat, event) to keep adding expenses and see who owes whom, not just a one-time calculation. Creates a group and returns a link anyone can open without signing up to add and edit expenses. Anyone with the link can edit it, so share it only with the group. Creates a saved page, so only call it when the user wants a shared group. For a one-off answer use halves_settle_up. Example: {"name": "Lisbon trip", "currency": "EUR", "people": ["Ana", "Ben", "Cy"]}.

expenses.description: Optional starting expenses (up to 50), same shape as the settle tool.
